# freshdesk_canned_response_folder (Resource)

A folder grouping canned responses.

~> The Freshdesk API offers no way to delete a folder. Destroying this resource removes it from state and warns; the folder itself stays until it is deleted in the portal.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the folder.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the folder was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the folder.
- `personal` (Boolean) Whether this is an agent's private folder.
- `responses_count` (Number) Number of canned responses in the folder.
- `updated_at` (String) When the folder was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_canned_response_folder.example 42
```
